properties.description: Detects three or more unique failed Azure control-plane operations from the same account and source IP within ten minutes.
properties.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where ActivityStatusValue in~ ("Failed", "Failure")
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by CorrelationId
| summarize
    FailureCount=count(),
    FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated),
    Operations=make_set(OperationNameValue, 20),
    ResourceGroups=make_set(ResourceGroup, 20),
    CorrelationIds=make_set(CorrelationId, 20)
    by Caller, CallerIpAddress
| where FailureCount >= 3
| extend
    TimeGenerated=LastSeen,
    AccountName=iff(
        Caller contains "@",
        tostring(split(Caller, "@")[0]),
        Caller
    ),
    AccountUPNSuffix=iff(
        Caller contains "@",
        tostring(split(Caller, "@")[1]),
        ""
    ),
    Operations=tostring(Operations),
    ResourceGroups=tostring(ResourceGroups),
    CorrelationIds=tostring(CorrelationIds)
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen,
    FailureCount,
    Caller,
    AccountName,
    AccountUPNSuffix,
    CallerIpAddress,
    Operations,
    ResourceGroups,
    CorrelationIds
